IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) for filling project-based research positions under their sponsored projects.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati has advertised for the post of Associate Project Engineer under advertisement number 2627R-0499-MECH0590SESS for a specific project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Associate Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Associate Project Engineer position in this recruitment notification released by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Associate Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Engineering OR a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Design along with 3 years of experience in Mechanical or Manufacturing fields.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total salary offered for the Associate Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Associate Project Engineer post will receive a total monthly amount of Rs. 42,550, which includes pay, HRA, and medical allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection mode for IIT Guwahati Associate Project Engineer Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is completely based on a Walk-in Interview where candidates must appear in person with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Associate Project Engineer post at IIT Guwahati is scheduled to be held on 1 October 2026 at 12 Noon.

faq.question: Q8. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to report for the walk-in interview at C Block, HoD Meeting room, Mechanical Engineering Department, IIT Guwahati, Assam, Pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or applying for the Associate Project Engineer post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Research & Development Cell recruitment portal of IIT Guwahati at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/ to view details and apply online.
